note: Descriptive structural analysis of the INCONSISTENT support corpus recorded in R105-R113. No search, no new solve, no lower bound, no closure, no witness. Mismatch re-derived from stored vectors; axis inconsistency re-derived with a batched 16-RHS rank test. Correlations are descriptive (biased corpus, no p-values).

fullColumnRank.definition: coefficient matrix has full column rank on all three axes (nullity 0)

rankDeficient.definition: at least one axis coefficient matrix has nullity > 0

insights.claim: The corpus is 100 unique INCONSISTENT supports (96 rank 47, 4 rank 48); every stored state re-derives its recorded F_2 mismatch exactly.
All 100/100 supports independently re-derive INCONSISTENT on all three axes: every axis has at least one inconsistent coordinate system, so no axis can complete the exact solve.

Axis failure is severe rather than marginal: a mean of 9.703333 of the 16 coordinate systems are inconsistent per axis (axis means 9.45 / 9.95 / 9.71). The coefficient matrix mean rank is 42.82 / 43.09 / 44.76 across 47-48 term supports, i.e. mean nullity 4.22 / 3.95 / 2.28.

The corpus splits into two structural regimes: 52 full-column-rank supports (nullity 0 on all three axes; mm 16..78, median 30) and 48 rank-deficient supports (mm 32..160, median 52). The full-rank regime averages 14.865385 inconsistent systems and covers 61.711538 target cells; the deficient regime averages 44.541667 inconsistent systems and covers 24.979167 target cells.

insights.claim: In the overlapping mm 33..48 band (14 full-rank, 22 rank-deficient), F_2 mismatch does not separate the regimes: full-rank supports are denser (984.285714 products, 399.214286 distinct cells) and cover more target cells (61.357143), but carry higher integer error (340.571429) and more false positives (39.714286); rank-deficient supports are sparse (125.136364 products) with many false negatives (37.136364) and lower integer error (85.772727).
The mildest axis (fewest inconsistent coordinate systems on average) is axis 0; per-support closest-axis counts are {"0":41,"1":20,"2":39}.

Factor masks are overwhelmingly rank 1: rank-1 share u/v/w = 0.64966 / 0.688988 / 0.720876; mean span ranks are u/v/w = 15.69 / 15.67 / 15.65 over 47-48 terms (so each factor spans only about a quarter to a third of F_2^16).

Mismatch does not separate on axis rank or span rank: the strongest core-scope Spearman correlations are targetCovered (rho=-0.679677), axisInconsistentFsSum (rho=0.675776), totalBits (rho=-0.528705). 4 feature(s) reach |rho| >= 0.5: targetCovered, axisInconsistentFsSum, totalBits, totalProducts.

Close-third vs far-third contrast (core scope, close <= 30, far >= 39): 17 feature(s) reach |d| >= 0.33: axisInconsistentFsSum (d=0.934156, large), targetCovered (d=-0.903978, large), totalProducts (d=-0.836763, large), totalBits (d=-0.8107, large), uBits (d=-0.544582, large), axisCoefRank0 (d=-0.526749, large), axisCoefRank1 (d=-0.526749, large), vBits (d=-0.508916, large), distinctCells (d=-0.48011, large), rank1ShareU (d=0.48011, large), rank2PlusShareU (d=-0.48011, large), wBits (d=-0.469136, medium), axisNullitySum (d=0.444444, medium), rank1ShareW (d=0.407407, medium), integerMismatches (d=0.374486, medium), rank1ShareV (d=0.374486, medium), axisCoefRank2 (d=-0.337449, medium).

The recorded integer mismatch is only moderately associated with the F_2 mismatch across all 100 supports (Spearman rho=0.541523); within the core mm<=78 scope the association weakens to rho=0.243587 because the two structural regimes mix a dense/high-integer-error family with a sparse/low-integer-error family at similar F_2 distance. F_2 closeness and integer closeness are different signals.
In-window R109-R112 supports (n=25) reproduce the corpus pattern: strongest correlations targetCovered (rho=-0.975801), integerMismatches (rho=0.612186); strongest contrast targetCovered (d=-1).
Mismatch range is 16..160 (median 38); the 4 rank-48 supports sit at mm 16, 16, 16, 20.

Coarse axis-severity clusters (per-axis buckets none/low-1-4/mid-5-8/high-9-15/full-16) yield 19 patterns; the largest is full-16,full-16,full-16 (count 21, mm 36..157). The finer 16-coordinate signatures fragment into 58 patterns, so severity buckets are the stabler description.
